meta.title: Beyond the Veil · A Halloween Transformation
meta.description: A private, alcohol-free Halloween gathering, October 31 to November 1, 2026, in the hills of Lakeway, TX. Two stages until sunrise.

hero.title: Beyond the Veil
hero.subtitle: A Halloween Transformation

paragraphs: You have been invited to join us this Halloween for a truly transformational gathering we call Beyond the Veil.
On the 31st of October, as the sun goes down and the veil between worlds thins, a gate will open in the hills of Lakeway to an estate that will become our playground.

For centuries, people have gathered at this time of year to mark the turning from harvest to winter and to honor those who came before. Disguises were worn as a way to walk between worlds, to become someone else for one night and pass unrecognized among the spirits.
This year, we're giving you a permission slip to wear a disguise that does the opposite. Create a costume that celebrates the bigness of your expression.
This event is your canvas, and your gifts are the paint. Be bold, be wild, and play BIG!!
Inside the gates, every expression is honored: your movement, your voice, your dance, and your vibration.
As we move beyond the veil, let the friction fall away, let your “try” die, and let your gifts live.

Everything you need to walk between worlds is below: the flow of the night, inspiration for your costume, and how to get your tickets, rideshare, and parking. Read on, and secure your place before the gate closes.
invitation.closing: See you on the other side,

statement: This isn't a show you watch or a costume contest. Everyone here is part of the art, and there's room for you to make some.

flow.name: The Arrival
flow.text: Doors open at 7 and close at 8. Check in and find your people.

flow.name: The Crossing
flow.text: The opening ceremony, led by Leah Free, sets the agreements for the whole night. Be there for it.

flow.name: The Night
flow.text: Two stages run until morning, with performances between the sets. At 2 AM the clocks fall back, and Halloween gives us an extra hour.

flow.name: First Light
flow.text: Sunshine plays the sunrise set as the sun comes up over the hills.

costume.text: Wear silver, violet, blue, chrome, pearl, or anything that catches the light. Disguises once let people pass unseen between worlds. This one should make you impossible to miss.
materials: Silver skin, glitter and chrome tears
costume.pinterest_text: Looks for men and women, pinned for this year.
costume.etsy_text: Headpieces, chrome, sheer layers and jewelry we'd wear.
costume.layers: Dress in layers you can move in. The night runs from a cool October evening to sunrise, and much of it happens outdoors. Costume shoes may stay on; everyday shoes come off inside the house.

tickets.text: Tickets are released in four tiers, and each tier closes when it sells out. The earliest tier is the lowest price you'll see.
notes: Refunds and transfers to a friend are both allowed.
If it sells out, a waitlist opens.
tickets.after: After you buy, you'll receive our Partiful invite. It holds the code to the ticket-holder guide: the address, the rideshare group and parking.

parking.name: Parking pass
parking.text: Parking on site is very limited. Passes are $50 per car; add one at checkout.

partner.label: Official supplement partner
partner.text: Beyond the Veil guests get 20% off LoveStack by VESSEL. Add it at checkout and pick it up when you arrive.

rules.name: Alcohol-free
rules.text: Grazing table, non-alcoholic drinks and water provided.

faq.a: Couples, singles, friends, collaborators, and anyone arriving as a new version of themselves. Every guest must be 21 or older.

faq.q: What kind of night is it?
faq.a: A party that's sexy, wild and wholesome all at once, held within clear boundaries and mutual respect. We never repeat a night, so please don't assume what this one holds based on past events. Our only promise is intention, craft and a few surprises.
Doors open at 7 PM and close at 8 PM. The opening ceremony begins outside at 8:30, and it sets the agreements for the whole night, so be there for it.

faq.q: Can I leave and come back?
faq.a: No. There's no re-entry once you're inside.

faq.q: Is there alcohol, and what's there to eat?
faq.a: This is an alcohol-free night. We'll have a grazing table, non-alcoholic drinks and water, plus tea service by Casa Akasha.
A private estate in the hills of Lakeway. The address is shared with ticket holders in the guide, which opens with the code in your Partiful invite.

Rideshare or arrange a drop-off. The ticket-holder guide links to a rideshare group so you can share cars with other guests. Parking passes are limited and sold at checkout for $50 per car. Never park on the road leading in: cars there will be towed, and guests who walk in from the road will be turned away.
A videographer will film the opening ceremony. Some spaces are camera-free, and we ask you to respect them.

faq.q: Can I get a refund or transfer my ticket?
faq.a: Yes. Refunds and transfers to a friend are both allowed. Email us and we'll take care of it.
A waitlist opens. You can also nominate as many people as you like for the guest list.
Costume shoes may stay on. Everyday shoes come off inside the house.
Please leave pets at home, and treat the property, art and furnishings with care.
By attending, you agree to honor consent, clear communication and the people around you. If you need help at any point, find any member of our team.

nominate.lead: Know someone who belongs on the other side?
nominate.text: Tell us about them. Every nomination is read by our team, and you can nominate as many people as you like. A nomination is not an invitation: if your nominee is selected, we'll reach out to them directly, usually within 48 hours.

closing.line: There are two hundred places, and this night happens once.

footer.noshare: This is a private invitation. Please don't post this link publicly.

guide.intro: You're through. Everything you need for the night is here. Please keep it to yourself.
